story.titleZh: 哈贾尔登台与车手首度大满贯巧合
story.summaryZh: F1官方账号发帖统计，哈贾尔每次在F1登上领奖台，都恰有车手收获生涯首个大满贯。帖子列举了2025年荷兰站（皮亚斯特里）、2026年摩纳哥站（安东内利）和2026年阿塞拜疆站（拉塞尔）三次例子。
story.originalTitle: Every time Isack Hadjar has scored a podium in F1, a driver has secured their first Grand Slam: 🇳🇱 Netherlands 2025: P3 - Piastri gets a Grand S...
story.summaryEn:
Every time Isack Hadjar has scored a podium in F1, a driver has secured their first Grand Slam:
🇳🇱 Netherlands 2025: P3 - Piastri gets a Grand Slam
🇲🇨 Monaco 2026: P3 - Antonelli gets a Grand Slam
🇦🇿 Azerbaijan 2026: P3 - Russell gets a Grand Slam
#F1 #AzerbaijanGP
detailZh:
每当伊萨克·哈贾尔在F1中登上领奖台时，总有一位车手拿到职业生涯首个大满贯（Grand Slam）：
🇳🇱 2025年荷兰大奖赛：第三名——皮亚斯特里获得大满贯
🇲🇨 2026年摩纳哥大奖赛：第三名——安东内利获得大满贯
🇦🇿 2026年阿塞拜疆大奖赛：第三名——拉塞尔获得大满贯
#F1 #阿塞拜疆大奖赛
detailEn:
Every time Isack Hadjar has scored a podium in F1, a driver has secured their first Grand Slam:
🇳🇱 Netherlands 2025: P3 - Piastri gets a Grand Slam
🇲🇨 Monaco 2026: P3 - Antonelli gets a Grand Slam
🇦🇿 Azerbaijan 2026: P3 - Russell gets a Grand Slam
#F1 #AzerbaijanGP
